content.short: Tradoor is a TON trading app for swaps, perpetuals, options, and prediction markets in Telegram.
content.description: Tradoor is a trading protocol built for TON and Telegram users. Its docs describe swaps, perps, options, price-lock execution, low gas costs, and access through web, mobile, and Telegram. The project positions itself as a simple self-custodial derivatives venue for users who want leveraged trading without leaving the Telegram flow. Tradoor belongs in TON DeFi because its main workflow gives users a way to trade, earn, borrow, stake, or manage liquidity through an actual product surface.
